class.name: rebot_controllers/MitJointController
class.description: Damiao MIT-mode passthrough: forwards position/velocity/kp/kd/effort tuples from a rebot_msgs/MitJointCommand topic to the hardware.

class.name: rebot_controllers/GravityCompensationController
class.description: Zero-gravity hand-guiding mode: kp=0, small kd, effort = clamped g(q) computed from the URDF (KDL).

class.name: rebot_controllers/MitTrajectoryController
class.description: FollowJointTrajectory action controller in MIT mode with gravity feed-forward and JTC-style tolerances.

class.name: rebot_controllers/JointImpedanceController
class.description: Chainable joint impedance controller (onboard MIT loop or software torque loop) with gravity feed-forward.

class.name: rebot_controllers/TeleopStreamController
class.description: Streaming teleoperation with velocity/acceleration smoothing and command-timeout hold protection.
